about.title: About Our Church
about.paragraph1: For over 50 years, Tabernacle Amour Pour Le Calvaire - Assemblée De Dieu has been a beacon of hope and faith in our community. We are a diverse, multi-generational family united by our love for Christ and our commitment to serving others.
about.paragraph2: Our mission is to glorify God by making disciples who worship passionately, love sacrificially, and serve joyfully. We believe in the transformative power of the Gospel and strive to create an environment where everyone can encounter God's love.

services.title: Service Times
services.subtitle: Join us as we worship together
services.tuesdayText: Dive deep into God's Word with our weekly Bible study. Experience transformative teaching and meaningful fellowship as we grow together in faith.
services.wednesdayText: Join us for a powerful morning of fasting and intercession. Seek God's face and experience breakthrough through dedicated prayer.
services.fridayText: End your week with powerful worship and prayer. Experience God's presence as we intercede for our families, church, and community.
services.schoolText: Start your Sunday with enriching biblical education for all ages. Interactive lessons that make Scripture come alive for the whole family.
services.worshipText: Our main worship celebration with inspiring music, powerful preaching, and authentic fellowship. Come encounter God's presence with us.
services.youthText: High-energy worship experience designed for teens and young adults. Relevant messages, dynamic worship, and real community.
services.praiseText: End your Sunday with uplifting praise and worship. A Spirit-filled atmosphere where hearts are refreshed and faith is renewed.
